name: Southern Rocketway Terminus
summary: The Southern Rocketway Terminus is a bustling transit depot built by the Bilgewater Cartel in southern Azshara. Perched high above the coastal terrain, the station links directly to the cartel's elevated rocketway and provides transit access toward Bilgewater Harbor and the nearby Secret Lab.

sections.title: Gateway to the Bilgewater Works
sections.body: Standing directly south of Bilgewater Harbor, the Southern Rocketway Terminus serves as one of the primary transit hubs for goblin operations carving through Azshara. Elevated above the rocky landscape with lift access to ground-level landing pads, the terminus anchors the southern end of the cartel's experimental rocket rail. Rocket-jockeys shepherd passengers along high-speed runs across the region, advertising the depot as the convenient jumping-off point for both the harbor docks and the secluded facilities of the Secret Lab nestled to the west.

faq.q: What is the Southern Rocketway Terminus?
faq.answer: It is an elevated transit station operated by Bilgewater Cartel goblins in southern Azshara. It serves as the southern anchor for their high-speed rocketway network across the zone.

faq.q: Where does the rocketway lead from here?
faq.answer: The terminus connects directly to the northern rocketway track, allowing travelers to rocket across Azshara toward the northern terminus and Bilgewater Harbor.

aliases: what is close to southern terminus
faq.answer: The terminus sits immediately south of Bilgewater Harbor and lies just east of the goblin research facility known as the Secret Lab.

faq.q: Are there travel services besides the rocketway?
faq.answer: Yes. A flight master operates from a dedicated landing pad situated at the base of the station's elevator lift below the main rocket platform.

angles.text: The entire station represents peak goblin civil engineering, coupling elevated rail scaffolding, rocket propulsion jockeys, and vertical mechanical elevators into a single transit hub.
For Horde travelers traversing Azshara, the terminus offers an efficient transit corridor linking coastal goblin facilities to local flight networks.
